2026-10-12T11:40:21.8627122Z  	  SELECT state INTO parent_state FROM "round_migration_17610492b250433ead546611ae7a4383".workflow_instances WHERE id=previous.instance_id FOR SHARE;

2026-10-12T11:40:21.8628030Z  	   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='workflow parent is not eligible';
